en: $s05What do you mean, rule the surface again?!
note: Female variant of MF02_0594. The declaration being echoed (Gore saying his people will rule again) is not in the text rows; the object of 'rule' is left unstated as in the source. Accuracy: object 'the surface' restored to match the male variant MF02_0594; settled by Gore's MF02_07CC in the same scene (chijou ni kunrin).

en: What in blazes does that mean?!
note: Editorial: question mark added (it is a question).

en: We Reptilians $s80$s13were born before mankind! $s80$s13We are the original inhabitants of this Earth!
note: Hachuu jinrui (reptile-people) is not in the glossary; rendered 'Reptilians'. Gore speaks of his own race; source uses the third-person race name, turned into 'We Reptilians' for natural speech. Editorial: 'the native life of this Earth' was stiff; 'original inhabitants' for senjuu seibutsu.

en: Quit spouting that self-serving crap! $s80$s13$s80$s13$f00dCrawl back underground and stay there!
$s80$s13Hmph! $s80$s13I'll show you monkeys the difference in power, $s80$s13$s80$s13$s05no, $s80$s13$s80$s13how far beneath us you are $s80$s13as living beings!
note: 'saru-domo' = 'you monkeys', kept consistent with MF02_096F. Editorial: 'teach you monkeys the gap in power' was unidiomatic.

en: $s80$s13To think you monkeys, $s80$s13$s80$s13no, $s80$s13you humans had such power!
Now that I've joined the Getter Team, $s80$s13you've got nothing to worry about! $s80$s13$s80$s13Sit back and relax, you're in good hands!
note: Idiom 'feel as if aboard a big ship' rendered as 'you're in good hands'.

en: $s05Hm? $s80$s13I don't see the Bear anywhere...
That bastard Musashi! $s80$s13After all that big talk, $s80$s13$s05did he chicken out and run off?!
The enemy's not gonna wait for us! $s80$s13Let's fight this ourselves!
The enemy won't wait for us! $s80$s13Let's fight on our own!
note: Female variant: softer, polite register (-mashou).

en: That's right! $s80$s13$s80$s13Back then, $s80$s13a massive bombardment of Getter Rays from space $s80$s13$s80$s13wiped out most of our kind, $s80$s13$s80$s13and we survivors fled underground!
But $s80$s13$s80$s13at the same time, there was life that bathed in those Getter Rays $s80$s13$s80$s13and evolved! $s80$s13That life was mankind!
If not for that, $s80$s13$s80$s13the ones ruling the surface today $s80$s13$s80$s13would not be you, $s80$s13but us!
$s80$s13Fearsome, these humans! $s80$s13$s80$s13Fearsome, this Getter Robo!
$s80$s13I'll let you have the victory today! $s80$s13But you haven't seen the last of me!
note: 'Oboete ore' (classic villain retreat line) rendered as 'you haven't seen the last of me'.

en: S-$s80$s13sorry to keep you waiting, $s80$s13everybody!
$s05Musashi!
note: -san honorific dropped.

en: $s05Musashi!
note: -san honorific dropped; identical to the male variant as in the source.

en: $s05You bastard, $s80$s13$s05where the hell were you at a time like this?!
note: Editorial: question mark added.

en: Now, now, $s80$s13the star always makes a late entrance-- $s80$s13$s80$s13whoa, whoa!
note: 'tto tto' read as Musashi losing his balance at the controls (Hayato's next lines criticise his piloting). Editorial: comma changed to a dash so the stumble reads as an interruption.

en: $s05All right, $s80$s13$s05I'm gonna send those guys flying!
You'll never beat them flying like that. $s80$s13$s05$m01gGo back to the Institute and let the Doctor take over the controls!
note: Assumes Dr. Saotome piloted the third machine before Musashi joined (MF01); 'hakase' = Dr. Saotome.

en: $s05No way! $s80$s13I'm not turning back after coming this far! $s80$s13I'll pull this off with my muscle and guts!
This here's MAP 03!
note: Debug/placeholder map label, translated literally.

en: %2The Getter Team made their way to the South America Base to take delivery of Getter Dragon and the Mass-Production Getters.
note: Only %2 in the source (no %0), kept as is. 'Nanbei kichi' not in glossary: 'South America Base' (patterned on 'Alaska Base'). Ryouhangata = 'mass-production' (not in glossary). Editorial: capitalised to match the glossary unit name Mass-Production Getter Robo.

en: $s80$s13Is that the new Getter?!
That it is. $s80$s13Our new pilot, $s80$s13young %3Benkei Kuruma%0, is at the controls.
note: Full name order given-name-first per glossary; 'kun' rendered as 'young'.

en: Come to think of it, I heard you're building other Getter Robos as well?
note: Subject 'you' (Saotome's side) restored; polite register toward the Doctor.

en: Once the current Getter Robo was complete, we launched several combat Getter Robo projects, each taking a different direction.
note: Passive in source ('were begun'); 'we' restored since the next row says he worked with Dr. Tachibana.

en: There's a whole bunch of Getter Robos?!

Together with a fellow Getter Ray researcher, $s80$s13%3Dr. Tachibana%0.$/And among the fruits of that work are the machines now in operational testing: %1Getter Robo G%0 and the %1Mass-Production Getter Robo%0.
note: First sentence is a fragment continuing his previous row (projects begun in cooperation with Dr. Tachibana); kept as a fragment. 'Mass-Production Getter Robo' not in glossary.

en: Dr. Tachibana? $s80$s13There are other Getter Ray researchers besides you, Dr. Saotome?
note: No gender_variant tag in the slice, but portrait code $f61 in mform.json marks this as the male variant (029B male / 02EB female). Verb restored ('There are') though the male source stops before it.

en: Dr. Tachibana? $s80$s13Are there other Getter Ray researchers besides you, Dr. Saotome?
note: Female variant (portrait $f62), full polite question.

en: Mm. $s80$s13At present, only three people in the world, myself included, have managed to make a Getter Reactor practical. But one of them has gone missing.$/Confound it... $s80$s13where in the world are they, and what are they up to...
note: Getter roshin = 'Getter Reactor' per glossary. The missing third researcher is unidentified here, so gender-neutral 'they' (per BASE_RULES); 'yatsu-me' rendered as 'Confound it'.

en: $s05What?!
$s05The Getters! $s80$s13The Mass-Production Getter Robos are--!
note: Cut-off alarm line; verb deliberately left unfinished as in the source. Editorial: glossary/project term: Mass-Production Getter Robos.

en: $s05What's wrong?! $s80$s13$s05What's happening?! $s80$s13$s05All Get Machines! Respond!
note: Editorial: questions punctuated as questions; contraction for spoken urgency.

en: $s05Dr. Saotome! $s80$s13$s05Can you hear me?! $s80$s13$s05Dr. Saotome!
Ah, $s80$s13Benkei! $s80$s13What in blazes is going on over there?
The mass-production Eagle, $s80$s13Jaguar, $s80$s13and Bear on standby... $s80$s13the trainee pilots jumped in, $s80$s13and every last one of 'em took off!
$s05What's going on?!
Having a spot of trouble, are we? $s80$s13My dear Getter Team!
note: 'shokun' rendered 'my dear Getter Team' (avoids 'gentlemen', Michiru is present). Speaker is Neon, unnamed until the next rows.

en: $s05You! $s80$s13$s05Who the hell are you?!
My name is %3Neon%0. $s80$s13On the orders of Lord Gore...
note: Sentence is cut across rows: no closing quote in the source; its continuation is MF03_076D ('...have come to destroy you'). English cut at the matching point.

en: You're with Gore?
Did you not notice?! $s80$s13$s80$s13We took the liberty of swapping our comrades $s80$s13for your human pilots!
$s05When did you pull that off?!
I'll be taking your trump card with me!
$s05You bastard, $s80$s13$s05get back here!
We've worked out where the Get Machines are headed! $s80$s13Judging by their course, $s80$s13it's the nearby major city.
note: Followed (MF03_09C9) by the researcher's self-correction to the nuclear plant; 'it's' restored.

en: $s05What did you say?! $s80$s13This is bad!
But we're up against Getter Robos! $s80$s13Even if they're only mass-production models...
note: Trailing off as in the source. Editorial: 'the enemy is Getter Robo' read stiffly and clashed with the plural 'they're' that follows.

en: Don't worry! $s80$s13$s80$s13Getter Robo or not, $s80$s13a Getter with lizards in it $s80$s13is no match for us!
Come to think of it, $s80$s13everybody was acting kinda weird!
note: Benkei about the trainee pilots who launched (they were the swapped-in reptilians).

en: ...have come to destroy you all!
note: Speakerless continuation of Neon's MF03_071F ('On the orders of Lord Gore... [I] have come to destroy you'); starts lower-case to continue that sentence. If the game shows it as a separate page/line, a capitalised 'I have come to destroy you all!' may read better: flag for review. Editorial: shown as a new message: starts with '...' per the project decision.

en: With intelligence this paltry, $s80$s13you call yourselves the lords of creation? $s80$s13$s80$s13Laughable!
note: No closing quote; continues in MF03_089A. Editorial: comma after the fronted phrase for readability.

Well?! How does it look?!

$s05Growing, you say?!
At regular intervals it uses its stored heat to trigger cell division and grow even bigger.$/$f25bAt this rate, by our calculations it will cover the entire city within 24 hours!
$s05What did you say?!
$s05That can't be...!
